# [TASK] Implement Admin DeployControl UI component with target selector and workflow step tracker

## Task
Build the `DeployControl` component inside the Admin Dashboard to allow authenticated administrators to select a cloud target (Azure AKS vs AWS k3s), trigger one-click deployment or teardown via GitHub Actions API, and visualize live progress with a multi-stage stepper.

## Scope
Includes UI components, GitHub API workflow dispatch trigger, workflow polling state machine, and vitest unit tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Component renders cloud target radio options (Azure AKS and AWS k3s) and clear action buttons.
- [x] Triggering 'Deploy Backend' calls GitHub Actions REST API with `workflow_dispatch` and begins status polling.
- [x] Step tracker updates through 'Queued' -> 'Provisioning Infra' -> 'Deploying K8s' -> 'Linking DNS' -> 'Ready'.
- [x] Displays live session timer and estimated spend with single-click 'Tear Down' action.
- [x] Comprehensive unit test suite in `DeployControl.test.jsx` passes with 100% code coverage.

## Estimate
**Hours:** 5

## Notes
Delivered in commit `bfc11e5`. **Rescoped:** the component no longer exists — commit `469e304` removed the web-triggered deploy path entirely under ADR-015 (`docs/architecture/adr/015-local-only-deploy-trigger.md`), because a passphrase behind an unauthenticated `/admin` route was still a public trigger for real cloud spend. The criteria below are recorded as met at delivery; deploy now runs from a local shell via `./gradlew deployAzure`/`deployAws`/`deployLocal`. See #150.
